text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown has finally achieved her 
first G1 victory. She fulfilled the 
long-cherished dream of the Satono Group.

With that honor held close to their chest, 
where they headed next was—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for gathering here today, 
members of the Satono family. Today, we 
are here for none other than...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: No, no further words are needed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
She won! A Satono horse girl has finally 
reached the G1 summit—

text_block_list.name: Crown's Mother
text_block_list.text: Crown...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah!? M-... Mother!? I-if you hug me 
like that, we can't talk—

text_block_list.name: Crown's Father
text_block_list.text: Crown, well done... Truly... truly...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu... yeah. Dad, Mom... I did 
it...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kura-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Your first GⅠ 
victory—Satono's long-cherished dream is 
fulfilled!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You've always worked so hard, Kura-chan. 
Ever since we were little, all this time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been working hard... together 
with you, too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... A-Ahaha! I'm sorry, I should be 
congratulating you... but I...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...To fulfill Satono's long-cherished 
wish. That is the sole reason I was born.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Even though that's what I thought... I... 
still couldn't do anything..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to say congratulations from the 
bottom of my heart, but... I'm so 
frustrated... and my chest just hurts so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Dia...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because Kura-chan is a fellow Satono 
Umamusume! And a friend who's worked hard 
alongside me...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Because she's my... rival...! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —I know that better than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How hard Kura-chan has worked! The resolve 
she had every time she stood on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I... I know it better than anyone else! 
I know it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... My name is Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't let things end like this. I have 
to polish this brilliance more and more...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kura-chan—... No.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown! I will show you a glory 
greater than your own!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —...gh... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I accept your challenge, Satono 
Diamond!

"A few days after that touching moment. 
When I went to the library to look 
something up..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list:
Are you looking something up over there 
too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To celebrate the Satono family 
achieving their long-cherished wish, we 
decided to make a commemorative item.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Commemorating Satono Crown's G1 Victory," 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So, I've been thinking about commemorative 
gifts that the fans would enjoy, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"‘I can't tell what would be good, so I've 
been agonizing over it for the past few 
days’ ...right?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ It looked like you've been deep in 
thought for the past few days, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Do both of you have some time right 
now? There's something I'd like you to 
see.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here we have a limited-time special 
parfait to celebrate Satono Crown's first 
GⅠ victory~♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! I saw it in the proposal, but that 
really is a massive parfait.

This is a café operated by the Satono 
Group. They're currently holding an event 
celebrating their first GⅠ victory.
choice_data_list:
Indeed, it seems like a great way to 
unwind.

Indeed, it seems like a great way to 
unwind.

text_block_list.text:
Still, what in the world could that thing 
be that Satono Diamond wanted me to see……?

text_block_list.name: Crown's Fans
text_block_list.text:
That was so touching, wasn't it~~! Crown's 
very first GⅠ victory!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...! Those girls, they're always in the 
very front row at the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Even for an elite like her, breaking the 
jinx is..." Well, you can just blow words 
like that away!

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Even when everyone told you it 
was impossible, you didn't give up... You 
were seriously so cool.

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan B
text_block_list.text:
............ Maybe I'll try taking it one 
more time. That certification exam, I 
mean.

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the talent to do things 
smoothly like Miss Crown, but...

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, no matter how many times I fail. 
...I want to keep taking it until I pass."

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Just like how Miss Crown broke the Satono 
jinx...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan didn't just "win a GⅠ." Nor did 
she simply "fulfill the Satono family's 
long-cherished wish."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I brought hope to everyone, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That victory taught me... that destiny 
isn't set in stone. As long as you keep 
trying, you can accomplish anything.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The reason I never lost sight of why I 
run... was because watching Kura-chan run 
made me realize it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to claim a glorious crown that 
shines just for me... one that no one 
else, not even Kura-chan, can ever 
achieve!
choice_data_list:
So Crown's crown will become someone 
else's crown, huh

So Crown's crown will become someone 
else's crown, huh

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
My glory will become someone else's 
glory...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...The glory of winning a GⅠ wasn't 
achieved through my own strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because together with you all... we 
prepared thoroughly for victory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell that to all the fans as 
well. And—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided! A commemorative 
project!"

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're using it already! That's the 
"Crown GⅠ Commemorative Notebook," right?

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! With the "Future Crown Plan," 
studying for tests is a breeze! Plus, on 
the back cover—

text_block_list.name: Crown's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"There is no absolute destiny. Thorough 
preparation will overturn even hardship 
and bring you glory"!

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'll... definitely pass and send a fan 
letter. Saying, 'This is the glory you 
showed me!'

Satono Crown smiled warmly at the fans 
chatting away with notebooks in hand.
